execution: Sequential; one GPU job at a time; wait if GPU is in use
hypothesis: The additive and maxout branches may offer complementary benefits; compare both single-branch variants with the completed full baseline.
scope: Only stages 0-3; final stage 4 remains the original shorted P-scSE.
controls: Same full model construction/RNG, pretrained cache, split, augmentation, optimizer, loss, max 200 epochs, early stopping 30, source checkpoint policy, threshold >=0.5, offline evaluator, PFOM settings.
primary_endpoint: Final image-based Dice; validation selects checkpoints, test is descriptive comparison of every predeclared variant.
secondary_endpoints: PFOM bounded 1/0 and separate sentinel-2 proxy
training time and peak CUDA memory
test_disclosure: The baseline test set has already been analyzed. Hypotheses and variants are fixed before new runs; no test-based threshold/model retuning.
limitations: Removing a branch changes active capacity and compute; does not isolate aggregation operator independent of parameter count
Source duplicates and original paper split uncertainties retained
illustrative_examples: Reuse the first two baseline worst-positive, first two median-positive, and first two empty-FP examples; no outcome-based reselection.
